subject_name:
Phiên dịch tiếng Anh 1
English Interpretation 1
time_allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 0.5 hour final exam + 104.5 hours self-study
prerequisite: K15-K18: Passed EAL201 & SSC302c & LTG202 K19: SSC302c & LTG202/LTG301, or SSC302m & LTG202/LTG301 K20 onward: SSC302m & EAL202c

general_information.Learning-Teaching Method: Lectures, interactive workshops, AI-enhanced active learning, Field trip, Project Based Training, Peer and self-evaluation using AI feedback tools
general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 0.5 hour final exam + 104.5 hours self-study
general_information.Pre-Requisite: K15-K18: Passed EAL201 & SSC302c & LTG202 K19: SSC302c & LTG202/LTG301, or SSC302m & LTG202/LTG301 K20 onward: SSC302m & EAL202c
general_information.Description: This introductory course provides theoretical and practical training in English-Vietnamese interpretation and vice versa, focusing on consecutive and simultaneous interpreting. Students will develop listening comprehension, memory, note-taking, and delivery skills through authentic materials and real-world tasks. The course also integrates Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and speech-to-text software to support autonomous learning, feedback generation, and pronunciation improvement.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours. - Participate actively in all class and AI-based exercises. - Record and submit self-practice sessions via Edunext. - Use AI tools effectively and ethically. - Complete all assessments on time.
general_information.Tools: - TEDEd videos - Vietnamese news: VnExpress, Dân Trí, 24h, Tuổi Trẻ, etc. - English news: CNN, BBC, Reuters, etc. - AI Tools: ChatGPT, Copilot, TTS, YouGlish, Clipto, etc.

description: This introductory course provides theoretical and practical training in English-Vietnamese interpretation and vice versa, focusing on consecutive and simultaneous interpreting. Students will develop listening comprehension, memory, note-taking, and delivery skills through authentic materials and real-world tasks. The course also integrates Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and speech-to-text software to support autonomous learning, feedback generation, and pronunciation improvement.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain the correlation between a good public speaker and an interpreter.
Apply preparation techniques and attitudes to handle challenges during interpreting tasks.
Develop a personal note-taking system using traditional and digital tools.
Use strategies to manage complexity and speed in interpreting.
Identify units of meaning and clusters to improve interpreting accuracy.
Use general adverbial clauses appropriately in interpreting practice.
Interpret figures of speech and technical terms accurately.
Apply strategies to interpret quotations, allusions, and transpositions effectively.
Demonstrate teamwork and professional attitudes in interpreting activities.
Integrate interpreting skills across fields using AI tools for practice and feedback.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test student's ability to apply knowledge and techniques obtained in all 9 units of the course to interpreting in a business setting.
assessments.Note: Teacher is asked to write a field trip proposal with specific details and send it to the person in charge.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test student's ability to apply knowledge and techniques obtained in the delivered units (Units 1-3) to consecutive interpreting.
assessments.Note: The teacher will prepare a text for each student (≈200words, comprised of two parts, one in English [100 words], one in Vietnamese [100 words]), and inform students the topics of those texts in advance. The student shall prepare materials related to the topics to facilitate interpreting performance. On the test day, each pair of students will randomly pick 2 texts and take turns to read and interpret.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test student's ability to apply knowledge and techniques obtained in the delivered units (Units 4-6) to consecutive interpreting.
assessments.Note: The teacher will prepare a text for each student (≈200words, comprised of two parts, one in English [100 words], one in Vietnamese [100 words]), and inform students the topics of those texts in advance. The student shall prepare materials related to the topics to facilitate interpreting performance. On the test day, each pair of students will randomly pick 2 texts and take turns to read and interpret.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test the student's ability to apply knowledge and techniques obtained in the delivered units (Units 7-9) to simultaneous interpreting.
assessments.Note: The teacher shall prepare 5-6 audio files (≈2minutes/file) relating to several specific topics, of which the students will be informed in advance. On the test day, students will be divided into groups of 4 or 5. All members will be standing at different positions in class, simultaneously listening to the same audio and recording their interpretation using a smartphone. Upon completion, students are asked to send the record to the teacher immediately.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test student's ability to apply knowledge and techniques obtained in all 9 units of the course to consecutive interpreting (both ENG-VIE and VIE-ENG processes). Topics: 1. Education 2. Entertainment 3. Technology 4. Environment/Nature 5. Business, Economics and Finance 6. Tourism 7. Family and Friends 8. Health 9. Culture 10. Arts
assessments.Note: The teacher will prepare a text for each student (≈360-400 words, comprised of two parts, one in English [180-200 words], one in Vietnamese [180-200 words]), and inform students the topics of those texts in advance. The student shall prepare materials related to the topics to facilitate interpreting performance. Students take the exam individually. Students will randomly pick 2 texts, then listen to the audios or to the examiners to read the texts and interpret. Students are allowed to take notes in the exam room.
